- [x] **B4 — browsable audit trail.** A **React + TypeScript + Vite** front end
      in [`frontend/`](frontend/), built on
      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates

      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.

      [ThreeUI](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui) (MIT) — its design-token
      stylesheet, its light/dark/system + five-palette theme system, and its
      app-shell and browse-grid components. Six views: Overview, Cases
      (searchable grid with a per-case decision-trace drawer:
      timeline / certificates / raw), Compliance kernel, Fleet health,
      Negotiation, and Listener. `make dashboard` compiles it and regenerates
      `data.json` from the hash-chained ledger; `make dashboard-serve` serves
      it. Verified in a real browser: all six views, the drawer, filtering,
      theme and palette cycling, **zero console errors**. The Python builder
      also emits a dependency-free single-file `dashboard/index.html` for
      environments without Node.
